scope: Read-only independent review of null-attributes production semantics and controlled test design; no product edits, test execution, Cargo, CI, network or artifact download.

verdict: No blocking source defect identified in the reviewed three-state change. The controlled Windows tests remain unexecuted in this review; CI wiring is outside this r1 source review.

productionFindings.finding: Default, Disabled and File are distinct. Only exact /dev/null and ASCII-case bare NUL choose Disabled. Other strings continue through the unchanged configured_path and OptionalFile ownership checks; no generic device or rooted-path permission was added.

Some(Disabled) adds only -c core.attributesFile=/dev/null. Some(Default) preserves default global selection. Some(File) uses the original held anchor and verified Git-compatible path. Outer None still disables both system and global attributes independently. GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM/GLOBAL config isolation is not mistaken for GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM attribute suppression.

Configured existing/missing file identity, held-parent absence and before/after verification are unchanged. The exact effective config --path return remains in attr_path and is compared again, so semantically equivalent spelling changes are not silently accepted.

The real capture path still reads selected HEAD, source info attributes, official original and local attributes, builds and re-evaluates a mirror, re-evaluates original global/system input, requires equality, and performs input/owner checks before and after consumption.

designAdequacy: Classifier covers exact documented null spellings and 20 nonalias counterexamples; real Inputs tests retain unsafe rooted/drive-relative rejection and original bytes.

Command-policy test inspects the same production constructor and verifies actual held-file write exclusion; it neither installs a second command implementation nor injects prohibited GIT_* environment overrides.

The fixed child receives only its own standard XDG_CONFIG_HOME, not a private HOME. It checks its owned marker/config/global input and verifies the actual effective setting so external HOME/config precedence becomes a test failure rather than an assumed condition.

Six actual Git settings cover default, explicit null variants, missing file, existing file; selected repository attributes and held info survive, dirty .gitattributes does not substitute, and returned mirror is reconsumed through official Git.
Three raw effective-config transitions require old Inputs to return changed and fresh capture to observe the exact new value.

Timeout/observation error retains the exact owned XDG directory and does not claim completion; original child only is killed and timeout has a bounded two-second observation. No process-tree or name-based termination is added.
testReview.outputDelta: Parent forwarding of child libtest output now uses stderr; this avoids a second stdout test-result line. Exact one-line inverse restores r1. Original r1 source/check receipts remain unchanged.
coverageLimits: No actual Windows test was executed by reviewer. Strict cross compilation is type/lint proof only.
System-attribute policy is asserted through the real Command, not through a deliberately installed nonempty system attributes file.
The fixed child is not an additional independently counted manual/current/legacy case.
Success of this design does not establish cold Recover or the complete Windows/product stage; those original public paths require their own actual results.

officialSemanticsBoundary.boundary: This review used the previously sealed pinned official Git source excerpts and the present production call graph. It did not refetch or claim to reread unavailable full official source files.
